Project Overview
							An e-commerce app for a clothing fashion brand: This mobile application aims at providing a hassle free and enjoyable shopping experience to shoppers with the widest range of brands and products. Application is designed to enhance user experience through easy-to-use interface. Through the application shoppers can see the Product Descriptions in detail, Stock Availability, Offers & Discounts, Delivery Time, etc as mentioned below.						
				Features of Fashion Brand Application
Easy Login and Registration
Product Gallery /Product Page
Product Filtering & Sorting
Detailed Product Description
Shopping Cart & Wishlist
Mobile App Analytics
Customer Support
Order Summary & Purchase History
Easy Secure Ordering & Cancellation
Various Payment Methods/Options
Shipping options
Delivery Status Tracking
Push Notifications
